excerpts.label: Fed admits QT overdone
excerpts.insight: Committee unanimously agreed to buy $40B/month T-bills through April—signal they reduced balance sheet too much
excerpts.pm_takeaway: RMO is admission of policy error, but scope is limited vs $3T QT—don't extrapolate to full QE

excerpts.label: Reserves don't matter—it's bills
excerpts.insight: True driver: Yellen's 50% bill-financing flooded market, keeping repo rates above corridor; Fed buying bills to rebalance
excerpts.pm_takeaway: This is plumbing, not stimulus—focus on repo rates normalizing, not risk asset implications

excerpts.label: BTFP comparison
excerpts.insight: Similar to SVB's BTFP: $120B injection sparked 12% equity rally, 10% gold rally—but gold fully retraced in 2 months
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Any RMO-driven rally likely temporary; don't chase—especially with SPX at 6900 vs 3800 then

excerpts.label: Alpha positions: sell bonds on rally
excerpts.insight: Bearish stocks, wants to sell bonds and USD on rallies—capitulated to 70% invested but doesn't like it
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Even the cautious PM had to add risk; watch for failed rallies to re-establish shorts

excerpts.label: Asymmetric downside risk
excerpts.insight: With clean book, fresh assessment says asymmetric risk to downside—bond market, VIX curve key tells
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Dec VIX spread collapsed 240→140 on Friday—limited hedging in place, vol can spike fast

excerpts.label: Bitcoin's December curse
excerpts.insight: Saylor's 73K average cost known pain point; December historically murders overexposed traders
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Watch BTC channel break as leading indicator—crypto failing first while equities hold is negative divergence

excerpts.label: Own the wings
excerpts.insight: Not pressing shorts but owning upside (7000 calls) and downside—this will be a 'wingy event'
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Volatility regime, not directional—buy optionality on both sides into year-end illiquidity
